articles.summary: KEYNOTE-C93 showed median progression-free survival (PFS) was more than four times longer for these patients treated with KEYTRUDA as monotherapy (38.2 months) compared to platinum doublet chemotherapy (8.4 months) KEYNOTE-C93 is the first Phase 3 trial of a PD-1 inhibitor to show a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in PFS as monotherapy compared to chemotherapy in these patients Late-breaking results were selected for an official press briefing and will be presented during a Presidential Symposium session at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026 and published simultaneously in The Lancet Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced the first presentation of results from the Phase 3 KEYNOTE‑C93 trial, evaluating KEYTRUDA ® (pembrolizumab), Merck’s anti-PD-1 therapy, as monotherapy for the treatment of patients with mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer
articles.title: KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) as Monotherapy Reduced the Risk of Disease Progression or Death by 43% for Certain Patients With Advanced or Recurrent Endometrial Cancer With Mismatch Repair Deficient (dMMR) Tumors Compared to Chemotherapy

articles.summary: Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, N.J., USA (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside the United States and Canada, today announced that Paul J. Diaz, managing partner at Cressey & Company, will join the Company’s Board of Directors effective Nov. 1, 2026. He will stand for election by the company’s shareholders in May 2027. With the addition of Mr. Diaz, the Merck board will consist of 14 members. “We are pleased to welcome Paul Diaz to our Board. Paul brings extensive leadership and business expertise in the healthcare industry, and we look forward to his contributions and insights,” said Rob Davis, chairman and chief executive officer. Mr. Diaz is a managing partner at Cressey & Company, a private investment firm focused on investing in and cultivating high-quality health care firms. He previously served as president and chief executive officer of Myriad Genetics, Inc., a leading genetic testing and precision medicine company. articles.title: Paul J. Diaz Elected to Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, N.J., USA Board of Directors

articles.summary: Remigromig demonstrated non-inferiority in mean change from baseline in best corrected visual acuity versus ranibizumab at one year in patients with diabetic macular edema (DME) Remigromig is the first biologic with a novel mechanism of action to demonstrate non-inferior visual acuity compared with anti-VEGF therapy in a pivotal DME trial Despite available therapies, up to 40% of people with DME have persistent disease after six months, driving need for new approaches Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced the first presentation of one-year results from the pivotal Phase 2b/3 BRUNELLO trial evaluating remigromig (MK-3000, formerly EYE103), an investigational, potentially first-in-class tetravalent, tri-specific antibody designed to activate the Wingless-related integration site (Wnt) pathway, for the treatment of diabetic macular edema (DME). Results were presented today at the American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) 2026 Annual
articles.title: Merck Presents One-Year Results from the Pivotal Phase 2b/3 BRUNELLO Study Evaluating Remigromig, a Tri-specific Agonist of the Wingless-related Integration Site (Wnt) Pathway, in Adults with Diabetic Macular Edema at AAO 2026

articles.summary: Intismeran plus KEYTRUDA significantly reduced the risk of recurrence or death by 42% (HR=0.58 [95% CI, 0.45–0.75]; two-sided p<0.001) compared to KEYTRUDA alone for patients with completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma Benefit was greater after six months, following the intismeran immunization regimen, as intismeran plus KEYTRUDA reduced the risk of recurrence or death by 58% (piecewise HR=0.42 [95% CI, 0.30–0.58]) compared to KEYTRUDA alone in a pre-specified sensitivity analysis Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, and Moderna, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRNA) today announced detailed positive recurrence-free survival (RFS) and distant metastasis-free survival (DMFS) results from the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial evaluating intismeran autogene (intismeran; V940 or mRNA-4157), a novel investigational mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy (INT) being jointly developed by Merck and Moderna, in combination with KEYTRUDA ®
articles.title: Merck and Moderna Will Present Results From Landmark Phase 3 INTerpath-001 Trial for Intismeran Autogene Plus KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) at ESMO 2026 Presidential Symposium
